noncomputable def forestRegisterQuotient

heads.name: observed_compression
heads.header:
theorem observed_compression {Obs : Type*} [DecidableEq Obs] {n r : ℕ}
    (M : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (z alpha : Fin n → ℝ)
    (atom : Fin r → Fin n) (beta : Fin r → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ a, z a < 1)
    (hmass : (∑ b, beta b) = ∑ a, alpha a)
    (htail : ∀ q : Fin (M - 2),
      (∑ a, alpha a * tailVector M (z a) q) =
        ∑ b, beta b * tailVector M (z (atom b)) q)
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) {sample : Copy → X} (s : Code N sample)
    (i : Option E) (hs : CoLocated N s i) (hcap : liveCard s ≤ M)
    (readout : Code N sample → Obs) (output : Obs) :
    (∑ a, alpha a * observedQuotient N M s readout output (z a)) =
      ∑ b, beta b * observedQuotient N M s readout output (z (atom b))

heads.name: original_forest_register_compression
heads.header:
theorem original_forest_register_compression {n r : ℕ}
    (M : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (z alpha : Fin n → ℝ)
    (atom : Fin r → Fin n) (beta : Fin r → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ a, z a < 1)
    (hmass : (∑ b, beta b) = ∑ a, alpha a)
    (htail : ∀ q : Fin (M - 2),
      (∑ a, alpha a * tailVector M (z a) q) =
        ∑ b, beta b * tailVector M (z (atom b)) q)
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) {sample : Copy → X} (s : Code N sample)
    (i : Option E) (hs : CoLocated N s i) (hcap : liveCard s ≤ M)
    (register : V → Bool) (forest : Finset (UnrankedTree Copy)) :
    (∑ a, alpha a * forestRegisterQuotient N M s register forest (z a)) =
      ∑ b, beta b * forestRegisterQuotient N M s register forest (z (atom b))

heads.name: exists_uniform_original_forest_register_compression
heads.header:
theorem exists_uniform_original_forest_register_compression {n : ℕ}
    (M : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (z alpha : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ a, 0 < z a ∧ z a < 1) (halpha : ∀ a, 0 ≤ alpha a) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ M - 1 ∧ ∃ atom : Fin r → Fin n, ∃ beta : Fin r → ℝ,
      (∀ b, 0 < beta b) ∧ (∑ b, beta b) = ∑ a, alpha a ∧
      (∀ q : Fin (M - 2),
        (∑ a, alpha a * tailVector M (z a) q) =
          ∑ b, beta b * tailVector M (z (atom b)) q) ∧
      ∀ (N : RootedBinary V E X) (sample : Copy → X) (s : Code N sample)
        (i : Option E), CoLocated N s i → liveCard s ≤ M →
        ∀ (register : V → Bool) (forest : Finset (UnrankedTree Copy)),
          (∑ a, alpha a * forestRegisterQuotient N M s register forest (z a)) =
            ∑ b, beta b * forestRegisterQuotient N M s register forest (z (atom b))

heads.name: checked_original_forest_register_compression
heads.header:
theorem checked_original_forest_register_compression {n r : ℕ}
    (M : ℕ) (z alpha : Fin n → ℚ) (atom : Fin r → Fin n) (beta : Fin r → ℚ)
    (h : checkCompression M z alpha atom beta = true)
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) {sample : Copy → X} (s : Code N sample)
    (i : Option E) (hs : CoLocated N s i) (hcap : liveCard s ≤ M)
    (register : V → Bool) (forest : Finset (UnrankedTree Copy)) :
    (∑ a, (alpha a : ℝ) * forestRegisterQuotient N M s register forest (z a : ℝ)) =
      ∑ b, (beta b : ℝ) * forestRegisterQuotient N M s register forest (z (atom b) : ℝ)

proof_role: One finite full-Code fibre pushforward, instantiated to complete original register and rooted labelled unranked forest. Existing carrier-free positive atom selection and exact rational checker both feed the same concrete source reader. No new count chain, coefficient algorithm, matrix minimal polynomial or real elimination proof.
source_scope: All admitted original Code inputs; no canonical encoded-image restriction.
All-copy CoLocated at one actual original population and liveCard <= M remain explicit.
Every old carried descendant subtree and complete original register is retained in rootForest/register reader.
One atom list precedes every source/row/forest; no separate per-forest extraction.
Only finite Code fibres are summed; ambient unranked forest type is not assumed Fintype.
Mathematical compressed quotients are not legal positive biological factors.
Proper exterior panels/current-root grafting/private-seed marginalization/bin and physical exit/future contexts retain separate exact interfaces.
